name: N1291-DW8 (Hubble)
blurb: N1291-DW8, a dwarf elliptical galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: dw0317m4142-hubble
story: This small dwarf galaxy lies near the galaxy NGC 1291, where deep images turned up many faint dwarf galaxy candidates. Hubble visited it as part of a census of the satellite galaxies of nearby Milky Way-like galaxies, resolving its stars to measure how far away it is.

claims.text: N1291-DW8 is one of the dwarf galaxy candidates in deep wide-field images of NGC 1291, previously detected by earlier surveys
The NGC 1291 dwarf candidates concentrate toward NGC 1291
DW0317M4142 is a dwarf elliptical galaxy
DW0317M4142 is cataloged as a dwarf galaxy of elliptical morphology
Hubble program 18061 is a census of satellite galaxies within Milky Way-like systems
The program aims to resolve the dwarfs' stars to measure their distances
